senses.gloss: (frequ. miscopied אפיפ׳, and with ר for ד) c. (ὑποπόδιον) footstool to the throne or to a high chair of distinction.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 24:10">Targ. Y. Ex. XXIV, 10</cite> (corr. acc.).—Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᶜ bot. after building the throne, he makes <he>אפו׳ שלו</he> his foot-stool; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1:5">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 36">Lev. R. s. 36</cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 16:1">Kel. XVI, 1</cite> <he>א׳ של בעלי הבית</he> (in Talm. ed. <he>בעל</he>) the people’s footstool of the household (a folding stool, cmp. <cite ref="A02462"><he>אַסְלָא</he> II</cite>). Ib. XXIV, 7 <he>ג׳ פנקסין יש הא׳ וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.) there are three boards or tablets in use (v. <he>פנקס</he>), that which is used as a footsool is susceptible of uncleanness by being trod upon, that with a receptacle for wax (writing tablet) gets unclean by &c. [<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 17">Gen. R. s. 17</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:19">Koh. R. to III, 19</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02700"><he>אֱפִיפְּיוֹן</he></cite>.]
